race.title: SIS Supporting Irish Racing Beginners Chase
race.verdict: KING RASKO GREY sets the standard on hurdles form and is taken to make a winning chase debut in a quality maiden, with the strength in depth at the yard making it no surprise that his chief dangers also come from Closutton, Kiely’s Place and Narciso Has both appealing as exciting recruits in their own right. KING RASKO GREY (FR) KIELY'S PLACE (IRE) NARCISO HAS (FR)
race.bettingForecast: King Rasko Grey (5/4), Narciso Has (7/4), Spinningayarn (6/1), Kiely's Place (8/1), He Can't Dance (16/1), Robertjames (16/1), Zanndabad (20/1), Sept Etoiles (20/1), Sutherland (100/1), I Can Find Em (100/1), Ready For Road (100/1), Maganey (200/1), Rock On Richie (200/1)
